units.source_text: ……最后，还有一样不想忘记的事，那就是对我的疑问，你自己最终也没能清楚的回答。

en.t: ...Finally, there was one more thing I did not want to forget: even you yourself, in the end, could not give a clear answer to my question.
I remember that it rained for two days straight.

units.source_text: 一下雨，沙崩威力增大，可飞沙的量要比平时少得多。

en.t: When it rained, the sand collapses became more powerful, but there was far less flying sand than usual.

units.source_text: 第一天稍微多干一点活，第二天可以轻松许多。

en.t: If we did a little extra work on the first day, the second day would be much easier.

units.source_text: 利用这难得的闲暇，怀着深深执着的心情，我决定好好地追问一下。

en.t: Taking advantage of this rare free time, and driven by a deep obsession, I decided to question you thoroughly.

units.source_text: 我要以剥去皮肤病上创痂那样的耐心，捅出留住你的真正原因。

en.t: With the patience of peeling a scab from a skin disease, I meant to probe out the real reason that kept you here.

units.source_text: 那种死缠不放的劲头，连自己都感到吃惊。

en.t: Even I was surprised by that stubborn, relentless persistence.

units.source_text: 一开始，你疯疯癫癫，赤身裸体地在雨中嬉戏，可终于被追问得掉下了眼泪。

en.t: At first, you played wildly and naked in the rain, but in the end my questioning drove you to tears.

units.source_text: 最后，你说自己不能离开这里的理由，没有别的，是因为丈夫和孩子的遗骨埋在这儿。

en.t: Finally, you said the reason you could not leave this place was nothing else: your husband and child's remains were buried here.

units.source_text: 有一天刮台风，他们和家畜棚一齐被埋掉了。

en.t: One day a typhoon struck, and they were buried together with the livestock shed.

units.source_text: 原来如此，这样的话倒是能够理解。

en.t: I see; put that way, it was understandable enough.

units.source_text: 非常实际，以前对我不说也是情有可原的。

en.t: It was very practical, and it was understandable that you had not told me before.
In any case, I believed you then.

units.source_text: 我又想好，第二天一大早，削减掉睡眠时间，去找骨头。

en.t: I also decided that early the next morning, cutting into my sleep, I would go look for the bones.
